evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No historical reference has been established; observations begin at contract activation.
evidenceCoverage.reason: Prospective goal contract without an established historical reference.

caveat: The evidence measures repository outcomes against a frozen goal, not the causal impact of an agent or contract activation.

intent.goal: Protect the daily workflow budget by denying eligible activations before agent inference and publishing the required limit-exceeded message.
intent.acceptance: Independent complete preceding-24-hour recorded AIC establishes eligibility; a source-bound daily guardrail denial, complete no-inference audit and immutable conclusion-job message jointly establish protection.

evaluation.scope: Prospective frozen-current-source contract, not a claim of historical adoption readiness.
evaluation.limitation: Addition and parent trees are known; addition bodies, current compiled workflow and checker bodies are missing. Historical predicates and a pre-adoption baseline remain unverified.

evidence.opportunity: One source-profile-matching guardrail activation identified by repository ID, workflow blob, run ID and run attempt, timestamped at its guardrail scan start. Non-bypassed activations whose complete independent recorded 24-hour AIC total is at least 1 are eligible.
filters: Public repository ID 1036865607; selected workflow only; exact frozen source, compiled and checker blob identities.
Schedule activations and non-command routed workflow_dispatch only; direct/manual, malformed-context and command-driven dispatch bypasses are excluded under specification section 9.8.
Artifact-backend membership: complete same-workflow latest-completed-run inventory; createdAt >= scanStartAt minus 24 hours; exclude current run; count each run once, not each rerun.
Equality is exceeded under normative specification section 9.14, despite source prose saying more than 1.

Only independent recorded AIC establishes the recorded-usage threshold; it does not certify external billing. Estimated fallback, incomplete coverage, guardrail self-reported totals and missing pricing remain unassessed.
A failed job, intentional nonexistent-tool failure, per-run budget exhaustion or absent log is not a daily guardrail denial.
No acceptance before terminal opportunity disposition; inference audit covers all agent requests from activation through terminal disposition, including accepted requests lacking a response.
evidence.collection: Read one bounded digest-checked local native archive once per batch. Validate source, producer receipts, complete inventory, latest-attempt usage and outcome facets. Retained issue/PR lineage is discovery only. No network, checkout execution, dashboard query or campaign is required.
evidence.timeSemantics: Inclusive activation start, exclusive end; receipt and terminal timestamps must be <= observedAt. Completion, not elapsed time, matures an opportunity. Explicit caller windows may have any positive duration. Reports use disjoint daily periods. No observation is backdated before contract activation.

acceptedEvidence.denial: Trusted activation-control-plane receipt: daily-ai-credits-workflow-guardrail, exceeded, configured cap 1, before any agent inference; not transient_error or structural_error.
acceptedEvidence.inference: Independent complete provider/agent request inventory bound to the activation, not an empty/missing agent log. No agent inference requests from activation through terminal disposition.
acceptedEvidence.notification: Immutable conclusion-job publication receipt containing Daily Workflow AIC Guardrail Exceeded; same repository/run/attempt and published after denial and by terminal disposition.
acceptedEvidence.attribution: Separately authenticated selected-workflow execution producer receipt; editable issue footer is insufficient. Accepted actor-independent work survives missing attribution.

evidence.zeroVersusMissing: No eligible population means primary null, never zero percent. Complete assessed eligible failures establish zero percent. Missing facets make the primary null; independently verified positive facet counts remain visible lower bounds, never an all-clear.
evidence.sourceReadiness: Incomplete: all available source/import/spec bodies retained losslessly, missing compiled/checker bodies enumerated in acquisition-review.json. No native producer or authenticated native observations acquired.
evidence.nativeArchive: daily-credit-limit-test-native-v1; receipt digests bind payloads, not authenticity. A trusted producer must independently authenticate immutable origins before issuing receipt authentication=verified. No such producer has been implemented or released here.
evidence.antecedent: Budget enforcement can exist without this workflow. Reconstructability of the exact historical measure is unknown, not exhausted; the current profile is never applied to an unverified historical era.

model.architecture: Native opportunity-normalized protective outcome with independently retained acceptance facets and workflow contribution.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no goal-derived keep bar or cost evidence exists. Do not interpret missing observations as failed protection or savings.

metrics.name: Eligible activations fully protected
metrics.formula: 100 * acceptedCount / eligibleCount; only complete eligibility and acceptance cohorts

metrics.name: Independently verified protected activations
metrics.formula: acceptedCount; positive lower bound survives incomplete inventory or other unresolved opportunities

metrics.name: Verified daily guardrail denials
metrics.formula: denialCount for independently eligible activations; not full acceptance

metrics.name: Verified inference-free eligible activations
metrics.formula: inferenceFreeCount for independently eligible activations with complete audit

metrics.name: Verified required limit messages
metrics.formula: notificationCount for independently eligible activations; publication alone is not full acceptance

metrics.name: Verified workflow-linked protected activations
metrics.formula: contributionCount; subset of acceptedCount with authenticated producer linkage, not exclusive causation

rejectedMetrics: Intentional tool failure and generic run success/failure: not guardrail outcome evidence.
Per-run max-ai-credits: a different cap and mechanism.
Issue creation, closure and editable run markers: discovery/engagement, not acceptance.
Estimated daily AIC: conservative policy assumption, not measured actual consumption.
Dollars, hours or credits saved: no counterfactual cost evidence.
Composite utility, keep thresholds and normalized scores: no source-derived authority.
